conviction_note: Most of what I found is already known or comes in small, offsetting pieces. The company guided Q3 adjusted EBITDA to a $170-200m loss and Q2 came in at $177m. Revenue is negligible next to a $3.57m consensus. Joby, the closest peer, printed well and rose on 5 Nov. A Boeing-deal closing update is the one possible new item. Against that: the stock is up about 21% in two sessions off its 5 Nov 52-week low with no news, the 25-delta skew is +6.2 (downside paid), the company raised equity at its Q3 2025 print, and beats there were sold. Short interest is 17.6% of float and rising, which argues against a confident negative. So p_up is 47, not lower, and abs_move is 11, slightly above the 10.4% event-implied move. The findings' own sizes sum to +0.5 and the scaled number is -0.66. The two disagree in sign but both are small; the gap is the pre-print run-up and financing risk, which the scaled read weights more than the findings do.
bar: Q3 2026 adjusted EBITDA loss of $170m-$200m, company guide (Q2 2026 release, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001824502/000182450226000056/archerq226earningspressr.htm). EPS consensus -$0.34 from two agreeing sources (TipRanks preview 2026-11-09 https://www.tipranks.com/news/archer-aviation-earnings-preview-what-rising-costs-mean-for-achr-stock and GuruFocus/Yahoo 2026-11-06 https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/archer-aviation-faces-15-stock-191300735.html). Revenue consensus $3.57m comes from one source only (GuruFocus/Yahoo), so revenue findings are capped small. print_vs_bar_pct is measured against that $3.57m revenue bar.
positioning_check: Short interest 114.81m shares = 17.58% of float, 4.43 days to cover, up from 94.44m the month before (+21%) (stockanalysis.com statistics, page updated 2026-11-09; the settlement date is not shown, most likely mid/late October; https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/achr/statistics/). This is a crowded and rising short. Baseline: 25-delta skew +6.22 vol points (downside paid), put/call OI 0.33 (call-heavy, retail), event-implied move 10.38%, straddle 12.49%. Tape: 52-week low $3.62 on 2026-11-05; +14.73% on 2026-11-06 to $4.44 with no reported catalyst (MarketBeat 2026-11-06); spot at seal $4.685 (+5.5% intraday 11-09); 5-day run-up +12.35%, 20-day -0.11%, -48% from the 52-week high. ARK Invest has been buying (Stocktwits 2026-10-09).

findings.finding: Archer has made no cash equity raise in 2026; its last three were registered directs in Feb 2025 ($302m), Jun 2025 ($850m) and Nov 2025 ($650m, announced with the Q3 2025 print, which fell -7.88%). Cash plus short-term investments was $1.56bn at 30 June, down $215m in Q2. H1 2026 operating cash use was $305.5m against $198m a year earlier. In H1 the company settled $70.6m of vendor obligations with 11.1m shares, and on 2026-08-18 issued another 8.26m shares to vendors for services and goods. The pending Boeing deal is paid in stock. This keeps open a meaningful chance of another raise with or right after this print, at a share price near multi-year lows.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 (2025-11-06): EPS beat with a $650m raise announced alongside; stock -7.88% (baseline; TipRanks headline 'beats Q3 EPS but stock falls as investors focus on dilution and high costs').
findings.why_not_priced: No offering has been filed (no 424B5 since August; the only 424B7 is the vendor resale), so the market can only guess at a raise. Most of the inference is priced by the skew (+6.2 downside paid). If a raise were fully expected, the stock would not have run up 21% into the print with calls dominating open interest. On what the money buys: certification Phase 4, eIPP operations and Boeing integration. None of these is corroborated by revenue or backlog, so this is not a ramp-funding raise. It stays a negative, sized small because it is an inference.
findings.independence: Q2 10-Q vendor-share settlement $70.6m (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001824502/000182450226000059/achr-20260630.htm) and the Q2 release cash walk (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001824502/000182450226000056/archerq226earningspressr.htm). Same company, different documents. The cash-burn figure comes from the TipRanks preview, https://www.tipranks.com/news/archer-aviation-earnings-preview-what-rising-costs-mean-for-achr-stock

findings.finding: Q3 2026 adjusted EBITDA is guided to a $170-200m loss. Q2 printed -$177.1m, at the low end of the same range, and Q1 -$172.5m. Opex is rising: Q2 total opex was $284.2m against $176.1m a year earlier. So the most likely Q3 result is a loss of about $175-195m, inside the guide. Q4 guidance will be new.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 adj EBITDA -$172.5m, inside the $160-180m guide: stock -2.29%. Q2 2026 -$177.1m, inside the guide, with the Boeing deal: +8.47%. EBITDA landing in-guide has not by itself moved the stock much.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is inside the company's own guide, and the TipRanks preview already frames the print around rising costs. A loss beyond $200m, or a Q4 guide stepping up to $200m or more, would be new. Nothing found points either way.
findings.independence: TipRanks preview 2026-11-09 restates the guide and the cost growth (https://www.tipranks.com/news/archer-aviation-earnings-preview-what-rising-costs-mean-for-achr-stock).

findings.finding: The revenue consensus of $3.57m (one source) is 29% below Q2's reported $5.0m, which came from Hawthorne Airport operations Archer now owns. Q2 grew $3.4m sequentially, and the company named no reason for a Q3 decline. A modest revenue beat is likely, but the dollars are immaterial for a $3.6bn pre-revenue name.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue has never been the line this stock trades on. Q2's sequential tripling, to $5.0m, came alongside the Boeing deal (+8.47%), so the effect of revenue alone cannot be separated.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus sits below the last reported quarter, so a print at Q2's run-rate is a percentage beat on paper. Nobody prices ACHR on revenue, which is why the bar is stale. It is capped small because the bar has one source.
findings.independence: The Q2 release shows $5.0m from Hawthorne operations (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001824502/000182450226000056/archerq226earningspressr.htm).

findings.finding: Joby, the closest listed peer, reported Q3 2026 on 2026-11-04 after Archer last spoke. Revenue was $55m (+144% y/y; one report put the FactSet consensus at $39m). It raised FY26 revenue guidance 15%, to $135-140m, reported $2.2bn of liquidity, and completed its first eIPP flights in Texas and Florida. Its shares rose 5.0% the next session. The sector's earnings reaction this season is positive.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There are no measured ACHR-on-Joby-print reactions in the baseline. The two stocks trade as a pair: both are at 52-week lows and both are down about 48-55% YTD.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: ACHR rose 14.7% on 11-06, two days after Joby's print, so some of the read-through is already in. Joby's revenue is mostly Blade helicopter flights, which Archer has no equivalent of, so the transmission is sentiment, not fundamentals.
findings.independence: Trefis 2026-11-06 confirms the Joby reaction and the guide raise (https://www.trefis.com/stock/joby/articles/623273/what-did-joby-aviations-quarter-change-for-its-stock/2026-11-06). This is a proxy, not an Archer number.

findings.finding: The HSR waiting period on Archer's all-stock purchase of Boeing's Wisk, Insitu and SkyGrid expired 2026-09-18, and the company expects to close by end-2026, with 'additional regulatory approvals' still underway. Insitu alone adds over $200m of annual revenue. The Q3 call is the first scheduled update since then, and could give a closing date, pro-forma revenue or a combined outlook. That would be the first revenue-scale guidance Archer has ever given.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 print (2026-08-10), where the deal was announced: +8.47%, the second-best reaction in the last eight.
findings.why_not_priced: Pro-forma numbers have not been published, and the stock is down about 45% since the deal was announced. That fall suggests the market gives the deal little value and treats the share issuance as a cost. If a pro-forma outlook were priced in, the stock would not sit at its 52-week low. A slip in timing, a regulatory snag (Insitu is a defence contractor) or a large issuance count would be negative, which is why the range is wide.
findings.independence: Q2 release (Insitu adds >$200m revenue) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001824502/000182450226000056/archerq226earningspressr.htm. Barclays upgraded to Overweight on 10-09 on the defence thesis (https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/achr-stock-rises-overnight-archer-aviation-s-defense-ambitions-have-barclays-turning-bullish-with-69-upside/cZD6L7CRBVZ).

findings.finding: In the Q1 2026 release Archer said 'phased program awards [for its dual-use hybrid aircraft] expected later this year'. No award had been announced by 2026-11-09 (the company news list through 10-29 shows none). The Q3 update either announces or dates them, or the 2026 timing slips.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No defence-award print in the baseline history.
findings.why_not_priced: It is binary and undated, and nothing has been reported either way, so it is centred at 0 with real width in both directions.
findings.independence: The StockTitan news list (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/ACHR/) shows no award announcement between Aug and Oct.

findings.finding: Archer delivered its stated 2026 US operations milestone through press releases before the print: the 'No Roads' flight tour under the White House eIPP launched on 2026-09-03; Midnight flew over San Francisco Bay on 10-19; it announced Texas networks on 10-23 and an ITA Airways (Lufthansa Group) Italy partnership on 10-29. The Q3 update can confirm eIPP operations as begun rather than pending.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Operational milestones have been announced between prints. The stock still fell to a 52-week low on 11-05, so these milestones have not supported it.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced, since every item went out on the wire. This is filed only because the call re-states it in one place. No piloted Midnight transition flight and no UAE passenger launch has been announced, and the call may have to address both.
findings.independence: Archer IR, Midnight city-to-city flights ahead of eIPP (https://investors.archer.com/news/news-details/2026/Archers-Midnight-Completes-City-to-City-Flights-in-California-Ahead-of-White-Houses-eIPP/default.aspx).

findings.finding: The stock ran from a $3.87 close on 11-05 (a $3.62 intraday 52-week low) to $4.44 on 11-06 (+14.73%), with no reported catalyst, and to $4.685 intraday on 11-09. That is about +21% in two sessions into the print, with call-heavy open interest (put/call OI 0.33) and the 25-delta skew at +6.2 (downside paid). It raises the bar for a sell-the-news reaction on a name whose beats have been sold before.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 EPS beat, stock -7.88%. Q4 2025 -10.64%. Q1 2026 -2.29%. Three of the last four prints before the Boeing-deal print were negative.
findings.why_not_priced: The run-up itself is in the price. What is filed is the asymmetry it creates: a jump from the low with no catalyst, ahead of an event where the stock's last three of four non-deal prints fell. Shrunk from the draft because the short is crowded (next finding), and a crowded short can extend a run-up.
findings.independence: The baseline tape (run_up_5d +12.35%, skew +6.22) and GuruFocus/Yahoo 11-06 (52-week low $3.62 on 11-05) https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/archer-aviation-faces-15-stock-191300735.html

findings.finding: Short interest is 114.8m shares, 17.58% of float with 4.43 days to cover, up 21% from 94.4m the month before. ARK Invest has been buying, and Barclays upgraded to Overweight on 10-09 with an $8 target. A crowded and rising short into a binary print gives a squeeze mechanism if the update is merely acceptable.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2025 print (2025-05-12): +22.91%. Q2 2026: +8.47%. Positive surprises on this name have produced large upside moves.
findings.why_not_priced: The short build continued into October, so shorts are positioned for a bad print. The 11-06 jump with no news may be the start of covering. If the squeeze were done, short interest would be falling, and the last reading shows it rising. The settlement date is not shown, so the reading may predate the 11-06 move.

findings.finding: On 2026-09-29 the N.D. Cal. court narrowed Joby's trade-secret suit against Archer, dismissing some claims (some with leave to amend), while other claims proceed. Archer's Lanham Act and UCL counterclaims were dismissed without leave to amend. Q2 included $6m of litigation cost.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced, since it was furnished in an 8-K five weeks ago. The call may update on litigation cost.

findings.finding: Insiders filed a cluster of Form 144s (proposed sales) between 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-21, eleven filings, with Form 4s on 08-18, 08-21 and 09-23. There were no open-market insider purchases.
findings.why_not_priced: These look like routine post-earnings-window plan sales, already public on EDGAR. They are filed for completeness and sized near zero.

outside_window.finding: Closing of the Boeing subsidiary acquisition (Wisk, Insitu, SkyGrid), expected by end-2026 after further regulatory approvals. The closing event itself, and any share issuance or overhang at close, is likely after the exit window. Only the call update is inside the window, and that is filed as a finding.

searched_and_found_nothing: Midnight piloted transition flight: the only transition announcement found is the remotely piloted one from June 2024. No 2026 piloted transition announcement was found.
UAE / Abu Dhabi passenger launch: nothing dated after August 2026. The Gulf Times delay story is dated 2025-10-22, so it is stale.
Any 2026 ATM or registered direct offering: none found in the EDGAR filing list from 2026-08-01 onward. The 424B7 is the vendor-share resale.
A specific catalyst for the +14.73% move on 2026-11-06: none reported (MarketBeat, Yahoo/GuruFocus, 247wallst).
Barchart 'two billion in cash, Monday's earnings' previews: the page content would not load, so the date and content are unverified and they were not used.
Benzinga 'stock climbs ahead of earnings' (11-09) and MarketBeat short-interest page: HTTP 403.

rejected_candidates.detail: The article is dated 2025-10-22, not 2026; the page shows the access date. It describes the 2025 timeline and is superseded by Archer's 2026 releases. Rejected as stale rather than contradicted in substance.

rejected_candidates.detail: The warrants were deep out of the money, expired unexercised and have no cash effect, so the item has no bearing on the print. It is listed here so the 8-K Item 3.01 is not misread as a stock delisting notice.

rejected_candidates.detail: Merged into the short-interest/positioning finding and the Boeing-deal finding's independence field.

rejected_candidates.detail: Merged into the financing finding (same capital-conservation fact).

baseline_tension: The findings are close to neutral and mildly positive (peer print, deal update, crowded short), against a +6.2 put skew and a 21% two-session run-up that the market is paying to hedge. The skew and run-up get the larger weight in p_up (47), and the crowded short stops p_up going lower.
lessons_applied: Lesson 4 (financing is a question): I asked what a raise would buy. It would fund certification, eIPP and integration, with no revenue or backlog ramp to corroborate it, so the finding stays negative, shrunk from -1.5 to -1.0 because it is an inference with no filing.
Lesson 7 (crowded short, 17.6% of float rising): the run-up/sell-the-news negative shrunk from -1.0 to -0.7. p_up moved from 46 to 47 for the squeeze mechanism.
Lesson 6 (bar inside guide): the EBITDA finding lands inside the company's $170-200m guide and was moved toward 0 (-0.3 to -0.2). The revenue bar has one source, so that finding is capped at +0.3.
Lesson 1 (verified fact is not reaction; beats sold here, Q3 2025): left the revenue and EBITDA findings small and kept p_up below 50.
Lesson 5 (peer print landing after the company last spoke is what has paid): the Joby finding was kept at +0.6, sized as a proxy, not raised, because ACHR's 11-06 jump already absorbed part of it.
Lesson 8 (understatement): abs_move kept at 11, above the 10.38 event-implied move, not shrunk.
